init.title: Bridge polling
init.description: Shared mode and interval for dials and buttons. Active mode starts temporary reads after the first event. Continuous mode also reads while idle. Dials and buttons use two bridge-wide batch requests.

error.button_target_required: Select a target for each enabled press type.
error.button_percentage_only: Select lights, or fans and number controls. Do not mix these two groups in one ramp.
error.button_percentage_invalid: Select a valid action and a percentage from 1 to 100.
error.dial_target_required: Dial requires direct short-press targets (lights, fans or number controls). Temporary takeover is available only on buttons 2–4.
